task: Build one-turn image editing toolkit (cutout/outline/SVG/select/recolor/eyedropper/fill) wired into all repos
resume_brief: Build the ONE-TURN image editing toolkit in ~/workspace/trippedd-studio, per owner directive 2026-10-11 (with Tyneshia): 'Gemini can in one prompt perfectly cut out, outline, SVG-trace, magic-select, recolor an area, eyedropper, bucket-fill — make yourself able to do that in one turn instead of taking too many tokens and turns.' FIRST: donor-first search (repo AGENTS.md law) — check tools/, animation-kit, existing branches, and sibling repos (God-Molecule-Show-Studio, God-molecule-production-stage) for existing cutout/select/recolor/vectorize tools; reuse before building. THEN build what is missing as ONE unified CLI, e.g. tools/image-edit/edit.py, with chainable ops in a single call: cutout (subject extraction — reuse the smart-extract rembg ladder at tools/smart-extract/), outline (clean edge trace of subject), svg (raster-to-vector via vtracer — pip install vtracer, /bin/bash), select (mask a region by description/coords via visual grounding + rembg/SAM if cheap), recolor (recolor masked area to a target color, natural HSV shift), eyedropper (report color at point/region), fill (bucket fill a region), restore (basic photo restoration — denoise/deblur — only if cheap, owner cited AI photo-restoration groups as the bar). DESIGN RULES: one command = one finished job; every op vision-verifies its own output (see->verify loop per SMART-WAY LAW); JSON report of what was done; /bin/bash free tools only; never AI-generate new imagery, only edit the input. WIRE IT UP per the POCKET-STUDIO/KIT WIRING LAW: into Pocket Studio (server.py + Colab notebook endpoints) AND the animation-kit in all production repos — no tool lives only in one conversation. Work on branch feat/oneturn-edit-toolkit off origin/main, commit incrementally, heartbeat ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/oneturn-edit-toolkit.json every 10 min, open a PR when done (do NOT merge). Proving run: take the Goodville key art and in ONE command produce: cutout of Amos Jr. + SVG trace of him, and report token/turn cost vs the old multi-turn way. Report: tool location, ops list, donor findings, proving-run results, wiring status, what could NOT be built. Mark checkpoint done at the end.
